brand summary.$value: Transforming complex domains into clear, direction‑setting product foundations. I combine deep research, systems‑level framing, and AI‑supported exploration to define what a product should be, scale clarity across teams, and turn ambiguity into confident forward motion.

brand summary updated.$value: Advanced UX skills built over 10+ years: architecting design systems from token to developer handoff, and running qualitative research that spans SME interviews under security constraints and field studies with flight crews and frontline disaster‑response teams. Layout, color, typography, and motion carry over from an earlier career in art direction and print production. Applied today to WCAG‑grade accessibility, B2B SaaS micro‑interaction design, and an increasingly AI‑native prototyping practice.

identity.$value: A curated selection of UX case studies from Jürgen Mantzke, Product Designer

paragraph 1.$value: Fake Papoose is the alias I create music under. I have created thirteen tracks in GarageBand since 2024, and I continue to compose new songs. This is a sampling of six curated tracks from my body of work.

paragraph 2.$value: I do not sing, so any vocals in my songs are samples taken from podcasts, movies, tv shows and video games.

paragraph 3.$value: My inspiration comes from the industrial and EBM music I have listened to most of my life. The strongest influences are Juno Reactor, Front 242, Front Line Assembly, Nitzer Ebb, Meat Beat Manifesto, and Circle of Dust.

paragraph 4.$value: This is a hobby project, and the vinyl turntable here is an experiment to see how complex of a feature I can create with vibe-coding. I designed everything and used Claude Opus to construct it. The tracks themselves use zero AI for composition.
